pr_title: sql: treat memory monitor errors as retriable
pr_body:
Release note (bug fix): Memory exhaustion errors which can occur during schema changes are no longer considered to be permanent failures. These schema changes will now be retried rather than reverted.

This is just rebase of a PR by @ajwerner: https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/71816, with a minor change to improve test reliability.

Fixes: #120807
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/120806)

issue_context.title: sql: treat memory monitor errors as retriable
issue_context.body: Previously, if a memory or disk error was hit during a backfill it was treated as a permanent failure, but these should be treated as transient retryable / transient errors. Reverting the entire schema change might be extreme if there is any transient issue on the cluster.

review_comments: nit: could you add one more assertion here to verify that `shouldFail` is `> 2`? that way we are sure the error was injected.
